note: Village of Cecil campground on a small point on the east shore of Shawano Lake, beside the village dock and boat launch; the sites on the point's west side sit on open grass a few metres from the water. Mostly seasonal: the 2019 campground letter (the last the village posted) leases 36 of its 46 numbered lots by the season, and the village page now advertises only seasonal lots, so call the village office to ask about a night. --Claude
